logp.method_description: The distribution coefficients of NAP, Ru-NAP and Rubpy between octanol-water were determined by following OECD guideline (OECD, The organization for economic Co-operation and development, 1994) using the shake-flask method.13 3 mL of n-Octanol saturated water and water saturated n-Octanol were prepared by stirring water and octanol mixture (1:1) in two different vial for 24 h at 25 0C. NAP, Ru-NAP and Rubpy were dissolved in n-Octanol saturated water followed by addition of equal volume of n-Octanol and stirred for another 12 h. After that, biphasic systems are separated. Absorbance NAP, Ru-NAP and Rubpy were measured with adequate dilution. From the absorbance, concentration of molecules in water and in Octanol were caculated. Log PO/W was evaluated by using following formula. Log Po/w = Log([Compound in octanol] / [Compound in water])
